item.title: Kev: Open-Source Multi-Question Decision Models Built on Qwen3.5
item.description: Created by Turborepo founder Jared Palmer, Kev reproduces Jev’s isolated single-pass multi-question scoring in Apache 2.0 Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B.

item.title: Running Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Locally on Apple Silicon Macs
item.description: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF uses weight-level abliteration and GGUF/MLX quantization to run a 27B multimodal LLM offline on Apple Silicon unified memory.
